title: Chapter 1 • The Foundation: Tawheed
summary: Tawheed is the beginning, the middle and the end of Islam. It is the reason the universe exists, the reason you breathe, the reason every prophet was sent, and the only sentence that will save you when the sky splits open.

quote.primary:
“And I did not create jinn and mankind except that they worship Me alone.”
(Qur’an 51:56)
quote.secondary: “Everything in the heavens and earth glorifies Allah…” (57:1)

sections.title: 1. The Primordial Covenant – You Already Said “Yes”
sections.content:
“Am I not your Lord?” They said: “Yes, we testify!” (7:172)

Every soul testified to Allah’s Oneness before birth. Life is simply remembering what you already know.

sections.title: 2. The Three Categories of Tawheed (Universally Accepted Division)
sections.content:
• ✔ Tawheed ar-Ruboobiyyah → Allah alone is Creator, Sustainer, Owner
  • ✔ Tawheed al-Uloohiyyah (Ibadah) → All worship belongs only to Allah
  • ✔ Tawheed al-Asmaa’ was-Sifaat → Affirm Names & Attributes exactly as revealed

sections.title: 3. The Greatest Verse: Ayat al-Kursi (2:255)
sections.content: Recite it 3 times after every salah and before sleep → protected from Shaytan until next salah (Sahih al-Bukhari).

sections.title: 4. Every Prophet’s Core Message
sections.content:
ProphetCore Call
Nūḥ (950 years)“Worship Allah alone”
IbrāhīmSmashed idols, built Kaʿbah
Mūsā“Let my people go – to worship”
ʿĪsā“Worship Allah, my Lord and your Lord”
Muḥammad ﷺ“Say Lā ilāha illallāh and succeed”

sections.title: 5. Hidden Shirk Checklist (2025 Edition)
sections.content:
• Riyāʾ (showing off in worship)
  • Swearing by creation (“I swear by my mother…”)
  • Saying “If it weren’t for X…” instead of “By Allah’s will”
  • Fearing evil eye or jinn more than Allah
  • Relying on job, visa, or medicine more than tawakkul

paragraphs: The strongest person is not the one who lifts 500 kg — it is the one who can say “No” to his desires only for Allah.
Tawheed turned barefoot slaves into leaders of empires in 23 years.
If you leave something for Allah, He replaces it with something far better — in this life before the next.
insights: Perfect Tawheed = creation becomes your servant instead of your master
Shayṭān’s greatest fear = a teenager who truly understands Lā ilāha illallāh
People of pure Tawheed enter Jannah 500 years earlier (Musnad Ahmad)

Replace “I’m stressed” with “Lā ilāha illallāh” for 40 days

title: Chapter 2 • The Six Pillars of Iman
summary: These six beliefs are the oxygen of the heart. Strengthen them and the unseen becomes more real than the seen.

sections.title: 1. Belief in Allah → Complete Tawheed
sections.content: All three categories from Chapter 1 + balanced love, fear, hope, reliance.

sections.title: 2. Belief in the Angels → Your Constant Companions
sections.content:
• Kirāman Kātibīn (scribes)
  • Ḥafaẓah (protectors)
  • Angels who say Āmīn in prayer
  • Attendees of dhikr circles
  • Throne-bearers (8 on Judgment Day)

sections.title: 3. Belief in the Books → Final is the Qur’an
sections.content: Original Torah, Zabūr, Injīl + the Qur’an → the only book Allah guarantees to protect forever.

sections.title: 4. Belief in the Messengers → 25 Named in Qur’an
sections.content:
Adam • Idrīs • Nūḥ
Hūd • Ṣāliḥ • Ibrāhīm
Lūṭ • Ismāʿīl • Isḥāq
Yaʿqūb • Yūsuf • Ayyūb
Shuʿayb • Mūsā • Hārūn
Dhul-Kifl • Dāwūd • Sulaymān
Ilyās • Al-Yasaʿ • Yūnus
Zakariyyā • Yaḥyā • ʿĪsā • Muḥammad ﷺ

sections.title: 5. Belief in the Last Day → Full Timeline
sections.content:
1. Death & Barzakh
  2. Minor & Major Signs
  3. Trumpet of Isrāfīl
  4. Resurrection
  5. Gathering & 50,000-year Day
  6. Book (right or left hand)
  7. Scales
  8. Sīrāṭ (bridge over Hell)
  9. Ḥawḍ of the Prophet ﷺ
  10. Intercession & Eternal Home

sections.title: 6. Belief in Qadar → Four Levels
sections.content:
• Allah’s eternal knowledge
  • Writing in Lawḥ Maḥfūẓ
  • Allah’s universal will
  • Allah’s creation of every action

You choose freely → Allah creates your choice → You are rewarded/punished → Perfect justice.

todayMission:
Tonight’s Mission

Sit in complete darkness. Imagine every stage of the Hereafter happening now. Let yourself cry, then pray 2 rakʿahs of tawbah and declare the six pillars out loud.

title: Chapter 3 • The Five Pillars of Islam
summary: These five actions are the absolute minimum Allah asks in exchange for Paradise. They are gifts disguised as duties.

sections.title: 1. Shahada → The Ever-Renewing Key
sections.content: Say it once to enter Islam → renew it with every prayer, every adhan, every breath.

sections.title: 2. Salah → 50 → 5 Gift of Miʿrāj
sections.content:
• 17 farḍ rakʿahs daily
  • +12 rawātib sunnah = house in Jannah (Bukhari)
  • First deed asked about on Judgment Day
  • Prayer with khushūʿ erases sins like autumn leaves

sections.title: 3. Zakat → 2.5% That Actually Increases Wealth
sections.content: Nisāb 2025 ≈ $6,000 (gold) or $1,100 (silver). Pay yearly on savings, gold, business stock. Even half a date in charity can save from Hellfire.

sections.title: 4. Sawm Ramadan → Annual Soul Reboot
sections.content:
• Devils chained
  • Gates of Jannah opened
  • Laylat al-Qadr > 83 years of worship
  • Allah says: “The fast is for Me and I reward it” (Ḥadīth Qudsī)

sections.title: 5. Hajj → Once-in-a-Lifetime Rebirth
sections.content: Return sinless like the day your mother bore you (Bukhari). Best day for dua = Day of ʿArafah.
